subject: a lotus leaf over still water
pose: leaf low, curled rim facing light

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Frame one broad lotus leaf low over still water, its curled rim catching a narrow gold line of sunrise. Show delicate veins and a few clear droplets only on the nearest section. The green water reflects soft mist and becomes increasingly uniform above. Keep the leaf's silhouette calm and the lighting restrained, expressing serene renewal through one simple natural form. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
